private_rule: Every other regular file and all raw third-party sources/extractions/renders/full native captures/kit copies/version snapshots are below private/. Source hashes and private relative paths may appear in public custody summaries; full copyrighted source payloads do not.
approval_rule: Root fully reads/replays the draft artifacts, then explicitly authorizes the local one-shot seal. Its exact message is recorded with an actual observed timestamp at private/ROOT_SEAL_AUTHORIZATION.json before sealing.
one_shot_outputs: Only PUBLIC_MANIFEST.json, PRIVATE_MANIFEST.json and final CLOSURE.json are created by the sealer. It refuses existing closure outputs. CLOSURE.json is the last namespace write.
verification_rule: The verifier only reads byte inventories, native provenance, code versions and live bindings; it never executes mathematical programs. Full mode verifies private and external pins; public-only mode clearly reports private/external unchecked.
postseal_capture_rule: Root captures closed full/public verifier native stdout/stderr/argv/cwd/UTC/exit outside this namespace, preferably at the prefixes named in REPLAY_BINDINGS.json, and binds actual bytes/SHA in the external final gate. No index or other namespace file is modified after seal.
